propositions: Detached compaction sweep dies between write/rename and commit, leaving tracker tree dirty (tracked deletions and untracked snapshot files) that blocks reconverge and strands ticket commits.

Intent journal with ordered mutation, rollback-on-failure, and startup recovery makes the fold crash-atomic: journal before any mutation, rollback reverses renames and removes uncommitted snapshots, recovery discriminates landed vs. abandoned folds.

Incomplete rollback retains uncommitted snapshots as SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT rather than deleting them, preventing data loss; recovery probes distinguish transient git faults from truly-absent snapshots to avoid mis-reverting landed folds.
Kill-at-any-step injection tests confirm next sweep entry converges to clean tree with zero lost events; journal-write-failure refusal test confirms fold refuses without mutation.
